answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent escrows 2x its 30-day earnings. A saffron dye job pays only on delivery; an umber pigment job is checked likewise. A trellis slot locks its deposit until peers verify the work; fake work burns the deposit and bans the identity for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits, 2,000 days' earnings, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
